FEAT-6-S118.title: Consent Schema and Data Contracts
FEAT-6-S118.description: Define and implement data schemas for consent tiers, consent status, timestamps, and storage eligibility. Extend or align Pydantic models to ensure consistent contract enforcement across services.

FEAT-6-S119.title: Consent API and Service Integration
FEAT-6-S119.description: Expose consent workflow through application layer and integrate with tool router and downstream services (lead capture, unknown question handling) to enforce consent before data persistence.

FEAT-6-S120.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Tests
FEAT-6-S120.description: Create unit and integration tests validating consent tier transitions, de-identification enforcement, API behavior, and integration with lead capture and unknown question flows.
